analysis_type: post-hoc read-only analysis of existing formal candidates
research_object: the combined system of G_GA, R_GA and GR_GA full feasible libraries within each case and replicate
prohibitions: no GA or other optimizer execution
no modification of source arrays, historical results, figures or manuscripts
no use of discarded anchor-conditioned system_summary.csv
no substitution of the V17 endpoint/best-feasible/trajectory comparison for route membership

source.source_bits_interpretation: within-route G/R ancestry only; never used as route membership

deduplication.scope: within case and replicate only; never across replicates
deduplication.key: support/template integer ID plus every composition coordinate converted to the protocol's native precision integer lattice
deduplication.duplicate_merge: retain one coordinate and frozen evaluator output, OR route membership bits, OR source_bits, max latest_stage, and retain original row index for every route

selection.within_template_candidate_pool: the arm's own Q upper half, Q >= NumPy linear median/0.5 quantile; ties at the median are included
selection.first_candidate: highest Q; ties resolved by lexicographically smaller integer coordinate and then smaller union candidate ID
selection.subsequent_candidates: maximize minimum Euclidean distance in frozen evaluator-scaled coordinates to already selected candidates; ties resolved by higher Q, then lexicographically smaller integer coordinate, then smaller union candidate ID
selection.distance_scale: the frozen Problem.scale derived by the original no-anchor evaluator

common_support_layer.supports: intersection of supports available to all seven comparison arms within the same case and replicate
common_support_layer.per_template_n: minimum of the frozen case cap and the smallest upper-half candidate count across all seven arms for that template
common_support_layer.equal_output_condition: every arm uses exactly the same supports and the same n within every support

full_domain_equal_total_layer.template_candidate_cap: the frozen case cap after the same upper-half/farthest-point rule
full_domain_equal_total_layer.target_total_n: minimum selectable capacity across all seven arms in the same case and replicate; capacity uses counts only, not Q outcomes
full_domain_equal_total_layer.allocation: round-robin one candidate per sorted support ID per pass, following each support's frozen within-template selection order and skipping exhausted supports until target_total_n is filled
full_domain_equal_total_layer.shortage: record actual target, arm capacity and any unfilled count; never replace it by enlarging another arm or changing support order

sensitivity.bootstrap_input: the existing frozen V11 per-case bootstrap count arrays
sensitivity.allowed_computation: recalculate frozen-kernel predictions only for the final selected candidates; no fitting and no full-library sensitivity census

diversity_aggregation: template-equal over templates with at least two selected candidates
route_contribution: ALL selected-set exclusive and shared route membership counts
drop-one paired changes from ALL to each two-route arm under the same layer and output-size rule

forbidden: treating candidates or supports as independent replicates

budget_boundary.main_comparison: equal final output size, not equal compute budget
budget_boundary.reason: library rows do not retain GA attempt indices; accepted-event order omits rejected proposals and library construction mixes upstream candidates with deduplicated accepted visits

required_outputs: read-only input manifest and unchanged hash verification
per-case/per-run compressed union ledger with integer coordinates, frozen outputs, membership, source bits and original row mapping
common-support and full-domain selected candidate ledgers and index arrays
paired contrasts and drop-one route contributions
Chinese report defining supported, unsupported and unanswered claims
